hookText: POV: You caught the inn's new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: In the heart of London, 1782. I, Betty Ryal, a young orphaned maid, was taken in by the opulent "House of Joys." Tonight, I was assigned to the most prestigious suite. As I stepped into the dimly lit bedroom, I heard a soft rustling. I turned to find a gentleman and a lady sharing a most intimate moment. The candlelight flickered, casting shadows that danced on the walls. My heart raced as goosebumps formed on my skin, but curiosity overcame me. I watched, breathless, as they kissed passionately. What secrets will tomorrow bring?

The night's secrets are revealed! 🕯️
